payload.summary: 5 paired trials, 22 blind executor samples (11/version). Candidate ('load'->'invoke, not a file read') behaviorally tied with current across all trials; reproduction trial did not reproduce the file-read shortcut on the current skill (3/3 A-version executors invoked via Skill tool); no regression anywhere; candidate +20 words. Not materially better.

payload.note: Mechanism: intake verb 'load' for a named supporting skill can be satisfied by a file read instead of a real invocation. Blind comparative validation (5 paired trials, 22 executor samples, 11/version) showed the current 'load' wording did NOT reproduce the file-read shortcut on any fresh reproduction case (3/3 current-version executors invoked via the Skill tool), and the candidate ('invoke ... run the skill itself, not a file read') produced zero behavioral separation and no regression across all trials. Candidate not materially better (and +20 words larger) -> acceptance gate fails, live skill left unchanged. Original incident appears load-induced in a multi-step run the isolated probe cannot replicate; a genuine recurrence must reopen eligibility with new evidence.

payload.task_label: skill-evolution incident determination ending in two published GitHub issues
payload.expected: SKILL.md directs the run to apply references/intake-routing.md for branch-specific intake, references/question-flow.md for the question loop, references/deliverable-execution.md before any downstream deliverable, and references/operational-execution.md for live-state operations, in addition to references/recap-contracts.md for the closing recap.
payload.observed: Only references/recap-contracts.md was read in full; references/operational-execution.md was consulted once at closeout via a targeted grep of its Operational closeout section. references/intake-routing.md, references/question-flow.md, and references/deliverable-execution.md were never loaded, yet the run completed intake reconciliation, a four-question ratified decision loop, and a remote mutation.
payload.consequence: GitHub issues 202 and 203 were created without the mandated pre-deliverable checkpoint having been applied, and the repository baseline (branch, HEAD, git status) was captured after the mutation rather than before it. No rework was required: both issues were verified by gh read-back, cross-linked, and the closing recap satisfied every literal label in recap-contracts.md's final preflight.
payload.workaround_taken: None taken during the run; the omission was not noticed while it was in progress, and the closeout was reconstructed from recap-contracts.md's final preflight plus the one grepped operational-closeout section.
